top_signals.title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
top_signals.summary: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Judge indefinitely blocks Trump White House ban of three media outlets
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump had sought to ban media outlets MS NOW, CNN and Politico from reporting from the White House.
